notes.title: Download issues for Mac users should be resolved now
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We briefly enountered today a strange bug for Mac users which a Zero Byte download situation was happening on our game. This has been resolved - if you tried to download our game earlier today it's suggested that you delete your local content of the partial download (Right click the game in your library and select delete local content) The game should download as normal.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - 300 Dwarves
notes.content:
300 Dwarves is Now Available on Steam!

The Kingdom of Fairbridge is under attack by Goblins, Orcs and Trolls. Use your towers weapons and command your warriors to push the invading Goblins lead troops out of the kingdom. Take the battle from the castle walls to the mountains, caves and desert valleys that surround the kingdom.
